info.name: ManatOS Multi-Platform API
info.description:
Postman collection for the ManatOS Multi-Platform API: server operations, authentication, metadata-driven SysBO CRUD, canonical/UI metadata, relationship delete-impact preflight, runtime configuration, public UI bootstrap, external authentication and security tests.

Hierarchy/Organization workspace note: the Principal Organization editor is a metadata-driven UI aggregate over owner-context entries[]. recordQuick edits, drag/drop/detach and Create Organization drafts are intentionally not separate REST resources. The authoritative persistence boundary is the generic SysBO $aggregate-commit endpoint. Create drafts remain browser-local and are cleared only after a successful commit. List-like candidate surfaces use the generic listExceptions exclude-when-true query predicate, which is passed through the API into storage before paging.

item.name: External Authentication
item.description:
External Authentication API presented by responsibility rather than by implementation detail.

Access model:
- Provider configuration and definitions: Admin Bearer token.
- Credential store/remove: trusted Admin/BFF; BOTH Admin Bearer token and x-internal-api-key.
- Runtime provider state: public/anonymous-safe.
- OAuth credential-test mechanics are internal UI workflow and are intentionally not modeled here as routine Postman client operations.

Stored credentials may exist with credentialsVerified=false. Such a provider is treated as not configured for sign-in until the real OAuth test succeeds.

item.name: External provider definitions
item.description: Access: Admin only (Bearer token). Returns the code-defined supported-provider catalogue, fixed callback paths, icons/scopes and setup guidance. Contains no persisted credential material.

item.name: Create SysExtAuthProvider (Configuration Only)
item.description: Access: Admin only (Bearer token). Creates the provider configuration record without credential material. Client ID/Client Secret are managed separately through the trusted credential-management commands.

item.name: Update SysExtAuthProvider Settings
item.description: Access: Admin only (Bearer token). Updates ordinary provider settings only. Credential fields and application-managed verification state are intentionally rejected by generic CRUD.

item.name: Get SysExtAuthProvider by Id
item.description: Access: Admin only (Bearer token). Reads one persisted provider configuration record. Secret material is never returned.

item.name: Delete SysExtAuthProvider
item.description: Access: Admin only (Bearer token). Deletes the provider configuration record.

item.name: External Authentication Credentials
item.description: Trusted Admin/BFF credential lifecycle. Requires Admin Bearer authentication plus x-internal-api-key. Client secrets are encrypted at rest and never returned by normal CRUD.

item.name: Store External Provider Credentials (Unverified)
item.description: Access: Trusted Admin/BFF only. Requires BOTH an Admin Bearer token and x-internal-api-key. Encrypts and persists the complete credential pair with credentialsVerified=false and credentialsVerifiedAt=null. This does not simulate verification; use the ManatOS Admin UI real OAuth credential-test flow.

item.name: Remove External Provider Credentials
item.description: Access: Trusted Admin/BFF only. Requires BOTH an Admin Bearer token and x-internal-api-key. Removes Client ID and Client Secret, clears verification state and disables the provider atomically.
